theorem_title: Universal quarter gap at an existing first coefficient contraction
natural_language_statement: For n,k,d in Nat with n>0, FirstCoefficientContraction n k, and shortcutIter k n=n+d, put s=orbitOddCount n k. Then 4*d<s and d<=(s-1)/4 using natural-number division. FirstCoefficientContraction means k>0, 3^s<2^k, and 2^j<=3^(orbitOddCount n j) for every j<k. The map is T(n)=n/2 for even n and (3*n+1)/2 for odd n. Limitations: Auxiliary theorem conditional on an existing first contraction and a nonnegative defect. It proves neither universal first-contraction existence, universal descent, universal convergence, nor exclusion of the zero-defect case or other cycles. Novelty and external priority are uncertified.
